text:
tara: FYI reseller PartnerX opened a dispute: they claim we overbilled for a bundled reserved+support bundle and want a $72,000 credit (covers Jan-Feb). They sent the packet to billing this morning.
ben: Do we have the reseller agreement and the price list they reference? link: https://drive.redwood/resellers/PartnerX_bundle_284000.pdf
mike: Quick read: reseller pricing had a promotional override for Feb (pricing experiment). Looks like billing applied list price instead of experiment price on several invoices. That explains $72k.
finance-ops: For month-end we need to decide: issue credit memo now or accrue a liability? Audit prefers accrual if liability is probable and amount estimable. PartnerX provided calculations.
tara: They want a credit applied to next payout, but sales says it'd be cleaner to invoice a negative line now and adjust revenue schedules. Concerned about messing with closed periods.
ben: If invoices for Jan-Feb are closed, issuing a credit memo in March is preferred and then we book an adjustment: reduce revenue for the periods impacted if the change affects transaction price allocation.
mike: From ASC606 perspective: if the pricing error materially changed the original transaction price for those historical invoices, we should correct prior period revenue (restatement) only if material. Otherwise adjust in current period as a cumulative catch-up. We should confirm materiality threshold with FP&A.
finance-ops: For close action I propose: 1) Create accrual JE for $72,000 today to Accrued Customer Credits 2) Create rev schedule adjustments for affected contracts to reflect the catch-up or prospective changes 3) Issue the credit memo referencing the accrual and attach the calculation.
tara: Sounds good. Can you draft the JE? We need dims for the two product buckets: support_bundle and reserved_bundle.
finance-ops: Draft JE: 
```
Dr Customer Credit Expense 72,000
Cr Accrued Customer Credits 72,000
```
Split dims: support_bundle 22,000 (dim rev_sched_px_support), reserved_bundle 50,000 (dim rev_sched_px_reserved).
ben: Once JE posts, billing can create credit memo CM-2026-03-PX1 referencing invoices INV-2026-01-2301 and INV-2026-02-2407. Attachments required per audit.
revrec-bot: Received request to update revenue schedules for rev_sched_px_support and rev_sched_px_reserved. Pending approval from @ben.
mike: Also note the Feb pricing experiment: cohort id 12. We need to exclude those experiment discounts from baseline SSP when recalculating allocation for future performance obligations otherwise we'll double count discounts.
finance-ops: We'll include an experiment flag in the rev schedule comment. Also running a reconciliation to confirm net impact by invoice line. ETA 3 hours.
tara: FP&A asked earlier for a materiality check threshold of $100k. This is below that but still requires disclosure in the month-end variance notes.
ben: Approve revrec-bot update. Post JE and tag closing docs.
finance-ops: JE posted JE-2026-03-PX1. Credit memo draft created and attached to the JE. Close tracker updated: "PartnerX dispute: accrual $72k; CM pending payout; rev schedule dims updated."
tara: Thanks. Once billing confirms credit applied to payout, we'll reverse accrual and post cash offset entries. Leaving thread open until credit applied. :white_check_mark:
